meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码的语法结构搜索并批量重写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在大量文件里按语法结构统一改代码
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by its syntax structure, at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to edit code by syntax pattern across many files

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按代码的语法结构（而非文本）来搜索和改写代码，覆盖 25 种语言；改写默认先跑预览，确认后才写文件，也能按 YAML 规则扫描出违规写法。
howto.when: 当你问的是代码结构而非文本时触发，比如查找某个形状的函数、调用或 import，或做整库 codemod；纯字符串、注释、文件名等文本搜索应改用 rg。

say.text: 把 console.log 改写成 logger.info，先出预览
say.note: 确认预览结果后再加 --apply 改文件

say.text: 找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: 按语法结构匹配，不匹配字符串文本

say.text: 扫描 src/ 下的 YAML 规则，列出所有违规
say.note: 读取 sgconfig.yml 里的规则并报告位置

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude searches and rewrites code by syntax structure (AST) rather than text, across 25 languages. Rewrites default to a dry-run preview and only write files after you confirm. It also scans YAML rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when your question is about code shape, not text: finding a function, call, or import shaped like X, or running a repo-wide codemod. For plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log to logger.info, show the preview first
say_en.note: Preview first; add --apply to write files

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter
say_en.note: Matches by syntax shape, not string text

say_en.text: Scan src/ with our YAML rules and list violations
say_en.note: Uses rules from sgconfig.yml and reports locations
